first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so simplifying onboarding directly addresses the two current funnel problems and is supported by prior evidence of improved time-to-value and early adoption. This is more sustainable than matching competitor pricing, whose prior use materially harmed 30-day retention. Verify the onboarding and activation records before committing, and monitor qualified activation, time-to-value, and downstream retention to detect any quality tradeoff.

final.rationale: Use in-product activation messaging this week. The verified record shows activation improved 6%, week-one engagement 11%, and 30-day retention 1%, directly addressing the current activation decline without the retention risk seen from shortened onboarding in complex-workspace accounts. Do not shorten onboarding for complex workspaces; preserve that approach only for simple accounts in a later segmented test. Monitor qualified activation, downstream retention, and account quality rather than optimizing activation alone.
